base_image_vulns._comment: TYPE 4: OS Base Image - NEW package zlib
base_image_vulns.description: Memory corruption in zlib compression library
base_image_vulns.remediation: Update zlib to version 1.3.1-r0 or later

base_image_vulns._comment: TYPE 4: OS Base Image - NEW package libcrypto3
base_image_vulns.description: Timing attack vulnerability in OpenSSL libcrypto
base_image_vulns.remediation: Update libcrypto3 to version 3.1.4-r0 or later

explicit_install_vulns._comment: TYPE 3: OS Explicit - NEW package bash
explicit_install_vulns.description: Command injection vulnerability in bash shell
explicit_install_vulns.remediation: Update bash to version 5.2.21-r0 or later

explicit_install_vulns._comment: TYPE 3: OS Explicit - NEW package ncurses-terminfo-base
explicit_install_vulns.description: Buffer overflow in ncurses terminfo library
explicit_install_vulns.remediation: Update ncurses-terminfo-base to version 6.4-r0 or later

container_vulns.description: Authentication bypass in auth-service due to outdated JWT library
container_vulns.remediation: Rebuild auth-service with updated dependencies and update to v1.6.0

container_vulns.description: XSS vulnerability in admin-dashboard UI components
container_vulns.remediation: Rebuild admin-dashboard with patched frontend libraries and update to v2.2.0

container_vulns.description: Remote code execution in RabbitMQ management plugin
container_vulns.remediation: Update rabbitmq to version 3.13.0 or later

container_vulns.description: Information disclosure in Elasticsearch query API
container_vulns.remediation: Update elasticsearch to version 8.14.0 or later
